race.comment: GRAFOLOGY (11) is yet to place in five starts but all his runs have been at city or provincial level. Tackled the mile for the first time last start at Kembla and he did a fair job to be beaten four lengths after copping interference. Great chance to break through in this far easier assignment. DENISE'S GAL (8) was tested over 1600m for the first time last start and was brave in defeat, hanging on for third in a Wellington maiden after leading. Won't find the chasing pack as tough to hold off today. OMINOUS (3) had a six-week break before an impressive third in a Class 1 over this course and distance recently. Lightly raced four-year-old who can win with a repeat of that effort. Bit of a gap to the others, headed by ROYAL AND READY (5) who backs up three days after a poor effort over 1400m here. Can improve over the extra ground. REDALUCA GIRL (10) has raced here twice over 1600m for two placings so she must be respected despite being winless after 24 attempts.
